Messages.Author: Gunslinger
Messages.Body:
I haven't noticed a particular ruling on this card, so maybe the question 
hasn't come up with other groups, but in a recent game here, there was a 
question about whether or not playing The Second Tradition on a vampire untaps 
the vampire or whether the vampire must first be untapped by another card.  
What is the popular opinion on this?  E-mail to jhs@ucsd.edu as well as a post 
here would be appreciated.  Thanks.  BCNU.
  --   Jon Schell
      Gunslinger

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
The Second Tradition untaps the vampire as part of its effect; you don't
another "untap now!" card in order to use the Second Tradition.
